name: Pepe's ArmorHUD
description: Displays the armor you're currently wearing as compact icons directly on the HUD, so you can check your protection at a glance without opening your inventory.
author: Pepe

changelogs.2.0.0: Added a full settings menu: screen edge, X/Y offset and size, vertical or row layout, alignment, reverse order, dynamic layout, spacing, empty slots, smooth slide, per-piece toggles and slot styles. Added a durability bar with a green-to-red gradient, durability text (percentage, remaining or remaining/max) with shadow and positioning, and a low-durability warning. Requires Pepe's Assets Pack 1.8.0 or later.
